C4 model, level 4. Solid arrows: uses. Dashed arrows: implements. MAX_CATALOG_ANSWER is 16 MiB and CATALOG_TIMEOUT 30 seconds, both fixed. One try, nothing stored (no outbox). A dataset is read with GET: no message to build or check. Without a bundle, AllowAll (portitor-dsp) stands behind MessageGuard.
